claim: Reality layer says whether what we are watching actually happened, and non-real layers get a consistent visual and audio treatment applied automatically so you never author the haze twice. Anime tells the audience 'this is a memory' with grain and desaturation rather than a line of dialogue, and this is the variable that buys that.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: dreamlike, hazy soft glow, surreal, drifting
memory, faded warm color, soft vignette, gentle haze
flashback, desaturated, high contrast, heavy film grain
hallucination, chromatic aberration, warped melting color, unstable
imagination, pale pastel unreality, soft sketch lines, weightless
storybook illustration, picture-book painting, illustrated border
digital, glitch artifacts, scanlines, wireframe, cyan data glow
afterlife, ethereal white glow, weightless, pale otherworldly light

look_at: dream/memory/digital/story_within all get distinct treatments; digital's glitch is excellent.
